entry.title: Porchlamp snapshot 2026-10-17: 11,000 open-source projects measured
entry.summary: We followed 614,499 pull requests from 148,789 outside contributors to 11,000 GitHub projects, from 20 April to 17 October 2026. 4,396 ranked, 5,299 gated and 1,305 unrated.

entry.title: Stars don't review pull requests: the state of open-source black holes
entry.summary: More than 1 in 5. In Porchlamp's 2026-10-17 snapshot, 638 of 2,745 active open-source projects (23.2%) left most outside pull requests with no human reply, review or merge within 14 days. More stars, more silence. The share rises with stars: 19% of projects with 1,000 to 10,000 stars, 30% at 10,000 to 50,000, and 35% at 50,000 or more.
